articles.title: Lift at Derker Tram Stop Out of Service Until Further Notice
articles.excerpt: The lift at Derker tram stop is currently out of service, affecting access for passengers travelling towards and away from Manchester.
articles.content_html:
A lift at Derker tram stop is out of service as of 5:10pm on 11 August 2026. The lift will remain unavailable until further notice.

Passengers travelling towards Manchester can access the Manchester bound platform via a ramp from Cromford Street. Those travelling away from Manchester can also use a ramp from Cromford Street and a track crossing to reach the Rochdale bound platform.

Transport for Greater Manchester has apologised for any inconvenience caused by this disruption. For more information, visit the Transport for Greater Manchester website.

Anyone directly affected may request a correction or right of reply by emailing news@rochdaledaily.co.uk.
